**[id 70]**
Judy teaches 5 classes per day on weekdays (Mon-Fri) and 8 classes on Saturday.
Weekdays total classes: $5 \times 5 = 25$ classes.
Saturday total classes: $8$ classes.
Total classes in a week: $25 + 8 = 33$ classes.
Students per class: 15.
Total students: $33 \times 15 = 495$ students.
Price per student: $15.
Total earnings: $495 \times 15 = 7425$.

**[id 71]**
First recipe instructions: 20.
Second recipe instructions: Twice the first, so $20 \times 2 = 40$.
Total instructions: $20 + 40 = 60$.

**[id 72]**
Brownies sold: 43 slices at $3 each. Revenue from brownies: $43 \times 3 = 129$.
Cheesecakes sold: 23 slices at $4 each. Revenue from cheesecakes: $23 \times 4 = 92$.
Total raised: $129 + 92 = 221$.

**[id 73]**
Cost per phone: $150.
Interest per unit: 2% of $150 = 0.02 \times 150 = 3$.
Total cost per phone including interest: $150 + 3 = 153$.
Total number of phones: 5.
Total amount to pay: $5 \times 153 = 765$.
Installment period: 3 months.
Monthly payment: $765 / 3 = 255$.

**[id 74]**
Round prices to the nearest dollar:
Marigolds: $2.74 \rightarrow $3$.
Petunias: $1.87 \rightarrow $2$.
Begonias: $2.12 \rightarrow $2$.
Total for marigolds: $12 \text{ pots} \times \$3 = \$36$.
Total for petunias: $9 \text{ pots} \times \$2 = \$18$.
Total for begonias: $17 \text{ pots} \times \$2 = \$34$.
Total earnings: $36 + 18 + 34 = 88$.

**[id 75]**
The top level (Level 4) has a square footage of 16.
Each level below has twice the square footage of the level above it (since the upper level is half the lower one).
Level 4: 16
Level 3: $16 \times 2 = 32$
Level 2: $32 \times 2 = 64$
Level 1: $64 \times 2 = 128$
Total square footage: $16 + 32 + 64 + 128 = 240$.
Average square footage per level: $240 / 4 = 60$.

**[id 76]**
First period: 180 days at 1 cup/day. Total cups = $180 \times 1 = 180$ cups.
Second period: The rest of the first year. A year is typically 365 days.
Days remaining: $365 - 180 = 185$ days.
Feeding rate: 2 cups/day.
Cups for second period: $185 \times 2 = 370$ cups.
Total cups in the first year: $180 + 370 = 550$ cups.
One bag contains 110 cups.
Number of bags: $550 / 110 = 5$.

**[id 77]**
Sarah does 400 pounds of laundry.
Raymond does half as much as Sarah: $400 / 2 = 200$ pounds.
Sarah does 4 times as much as David, so David does $1/4$ of Sarah's amount: $400 / 4 = 100$ pounds.
Difference between Raymond and David: $200 - 100 = 100$ pounds.

**[id 78]**
Option 1: Packages of 3 for $2.50.
To get 18 flowers, he needs $18 / 3 = 6$ packages.
Cost: $6 \times 2.50 = 15.00$.

Option 2: Packages of 2 for $1.
To get 18 flowers, he needs $18 / 2 = 9$ packages.
Cost: $9 \times 1 = 9.00$.

The better price is Option 2 ($9.00). The other price is $15.00.
Savings: $15.00 - 9.00 = 6.00$.

**[id 79]**
Original cost: $100.
Discount: 30%.
Discount amount: $100 \times 0.30 = 30$.
Cost after discount: $100 - 30 = 70$.
